review_comment: User-provided watchdog paths and node names are directly interpolated into system command arguments without sanitization. An attacker could inject shell metacharacters to execute arbitrary commands on the system. Sanitize or escape all user inputs used in command construction before passing them to run_cmd.

User input from params[:config] flows directly into system command arguments without sanitization. An attacker can inject shell metacharacters in option or value fields to execute arbitrary commands. Add proper escaping or validation of config parameters before constructing command arguments.

The function reads SBD configuration from a fixed system file without access control checks. An attacker who can modify the SBD config file could inject malicious values into cluster reports. Add authorization verification before accessing sensitive system files.

The function directly parses command output as JSON without validation, creating a potential data processing error if input is malformed. The command is executed with superuser privileges, increasing risk. Add input validation before JSON parsing to prevent unexpected behavior.
